notes: Operator-named 2026-08-03. The operator judged this "a genuine circular-prerequisite class of defect [that] generalises well beyond Corpus Scout" — hence `cross-capability` scope on the operator's own reading, with only one recorded site so far.

The split that resolves it: `domainConfidence` (sub-domain placement, provisional) governs disclosure; `confidence` (admission quality) governs disposition. `ingestApprovedSource` writes the source’s own recorded `campaignSubDomain` to the evidence row, never the lineage-derived placement, which is what makes the split sound rather than convenient.

canaries.assertion: A source with no invariant lineage keeps its admission-quality `confidence` while its `domainConfidence` stays capped and labelled PROVISIONAL — the two numbers are decoupled. The prior assertion requiring the coupled behaviour was replaced with its reason recorded.

statement: Admission confidence must not depend on evidence produced only after admission.

occurrences.defect: The Stage 2 recommendation engine capped a source's OVERALL confidence at PROVISIONAL_CONFIDENCE_CAP when no invariant lineage traced to it — and a source cannot have lineage until it has been admitted and extracted. On the first real Track 2 batch every source was provisional, every source was quarantined, and the executable cohort was ZERO. The feature intended to prepare the operator's decision had made the decision impossible.
